dispute_ticket.description: I arrived at the pickup point at 11.00 and waited 9 minutes. I called the rider at 11.04 and she did not answer. I cancelled as no-show but the S$8.00 fee was held because she disputes it. Please release the fee.

chat_logs.content: I'm at the main lobby, white Prius.
I'm at the main lobby too and I can't see any white Prius!
Hello?? I've been standing at the pickup pin since 10:55

app_events.details: Rider R-8116 booked RYDE-PX-016 to Novena MRT. Pickup 11:00.
Rider device location 6 m from pickup pin (GPS accuracy 5 m).
Driver pressed I'm Here; GPS 5 m from pickup pin (accuracy 4 m).
Driver in-app call, rang 30s, no answer logged on the driver side.
Rider app recorded no incoming call during 11:00 to 11:09.
Driver cancelled with reason rider_no_show. No rider_boarded event.
S$8.00 fee not credited: rider contested via RydeHELP.

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time to cancellation_time, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit is inclusive: a wait of exactly this many minutes already meets it.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: The decisive fact is whether both parties were at the pickup point. The driver's records (driver_arrived 11:00 with GPS 5 m from the pin, stationary GPS to 11:09) and the rider's records (rider_at_pickup 10:55 at 6 m from the pin, chat at 11:03 and 11:05) are each precise and consistent, but they contradict each other: both say they stood at the same pin and neither saw the other, and the driver's 11:04 call is logged as made but never received. No other record settles it. A person must decide, as a 9-minute wait would only count if the driver truly waited at the pickup.
